thread:
karen: during the quarterly entitlement sweep i flagged ~20 principals with KMS privileges but no entries in the evidence_ledger. some are vendor SAs, some are old human creds. need quick triage.

josh: can you share the query you ran?

karen: ```sql
SELECT principal, role, last_grant_ts, evidence_present
FROM entitlement.evidence_ledger_snapshot
WHERE resource_type='kms' AND evidence_present = FALSE;
```

rebecca: FYI telemetry shows a short ingestion blackout on 2026-11-03 05:10-05:55 UTC for the kms shard. could explain some gaps.

mike: infra note: that blackout was due to a consumer restart. we can attempt archival replay for that window. infra-bot, kick it off?

infra-bot: replay_request rj-20261103-01 created; status=queued. note: archived files older than 18 months may require cold retrieval.

sec-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-789 opened: "Evidence ledger gaps affecting KMS entitlements" assigned to eng-security. Priority: P3.

josh: quick plan: 1) try replay and re-populate evidence_ledger 2) if replay fails, cross-check deploy/PR metadata and access logs 3) if still no owner, quarantine entitlements and prepare JIT re-enable flow.

karen: agree. also pause sweeper auto-removals for any binding that touches `tag:sensitive=kms` so we don't break production.

rebecca: i'm exporting decrypt events for the affected principals to a locked project for analysis. command: `tools/telemetry/export --keys kms --principals @list --since 2026-11-01 --until 2026-11-05`

vendor-ops: we see two vendor SAs in the list; vendor contact says they provisioned the SA in 2024 but can't find policy evidence for owner. requesting 24h to dig.

infra-bot: replay rj-20261103-01 status=running. estimated 3h including cold retrieval.

josh: collector command to rehydrate: `tools/evidence_collector/run --window 2026-11-03T05:00:00Z/2026-11-03T06:00:00Z --resource kms`

mike: added a small heuristic to the collector to join git metadata and deployment timestamps as secondary evidence. PR: tools/evidence_collector#112.

infra-bot: replay rj-20261103-01 completed: status=success, files_replayed=1,120, bytes=1.9GB, window=2026-11-03T05:10:00Z..2026-11-03T05:55:00Z

josh: ran collector: recovered 13 ledger entries, 7 principals remain without ledger evidence. updating entitlement dashboard.

karen: list of remaining principals (redacted): 4 service accounts (owners unknown), 2 humans (on leave), 1 contractor (vendor).

rebecca: for humans on leave we can contact their manager for attestation. i'll draft the attestation email and runbook link.

vendor-ops: vendor provided partial attestation for contractor but missing PRs. legal is checking if that suffices for compliance.

mike: recommend immediate mitigation for orphaned service accounts: rotate keys and apply minimal kms-only roles until owner is confirmed.

josh: agree. set entitlement hold: `entitlement.sweeper set-hold --principals @orphaned_list --reason "missing_evidence"`

infra-bot: hold set for 7 principals. sweeper will skip removals but mark them as quarantined.

sec-bot: compliance note: record this remediation path in INC-2026-789 and attach replay id rj-20261103-01 and collector run id cr-20261103-08.

karen: action items: (1) vendor attestation follow-up (vendor-ops) (2) manager attest for humans (rebecca) (3) rotate and restrict orphaned SA keys (mike) (4) update sweeper to require explicit owner for any role that grants KMS decrypt (josh).

josh: opening PR for sweeper policy change to require `evidence_ledger.owner_email` for `role contains "kms"` bindings. PR #201.

mike: rotation run started rot-20261103-01 for 4 orphaned SAs in canary. monitoring decrypt error spike for 45m.

vendor-ops: vendor confirmed one SA owner; other SA still pending legal review.

rebecca: managers attested for both humans; evidence linked. updating ledger.

karen: compliance OK for humans; vendor/SA on hold until legal completes sign-off or we get PR history.

josh: follow-up: add nightly synthetic replay check for KMS shards and an alert if replayable gaps > 5m. infra-bot, can you schedule?

infra-bot: scheduled synthetic replay check sr-2026-nightly-kms cron=0 4 * * *. will run health check and emit metric logs.replayable_gap_seconds.

sec-bot: reminder: quarterly access review report must include rationale for any autorollback or hold decisions. attach incident and evidence links.

karen: i'll draft the report and the postmortem notes. target to close INC-2026-789 after vendor sign-off or final rekey.

pager: paging on-call infra in case rotations cause unexpected failures.

mike: canary rotations look clean, no decrypt errors in canary. proceeding to full rotation in 2h.

josh: thanks everyone. leaving this thread as the audit/ticket log for the entitlement holds. will update when vendor/legal closes. :thumbsup:
